speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. The loaf is on the board. It is still a thumb short of the notch, and it is still a penny.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I set it there as you said, mistress. The notch has not moved.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A full thumb, and a penny. That is yesterday's loaf still telling the truth.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Yesterday's butter was fourpence, where the constable stood. Do not improve it over a breakfast.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I am down, mistress. If I am asked, I am from Norwich.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are not asked at this table. If you are asked at the door, the answer is the one you already have. From Norwich.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And if nobody asks, you do not spend the sentence. You come, because not to come would be noticed.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I come with the house. Not to come would be noticed.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The church is full on Trinity Sunday. A bench with a gap in it is a thing the lane can point at.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then there will be no gap. You walk in with us. Sit until I say we go.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am sitting. I have nothing to carry to the pew but myself.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. I do not want a book in that pew, and I do not want a story from the street. Church, and home.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I cut the loaf now, or after the bells?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Now. Cut it, and do not apologise to the notch. The price did not change because the crumb did.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will take mine and be quiet about the notch.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will take mine. I have no other answer this morning than the one the mistress has already said.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not give another. Alse, the butter dish stays where it is. Fourpence was yesterday. Today is the loaf and the bells.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The dish stays. I will not tell the notch to the lane.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The lane will see the pew. That is the whole of what it needs to see.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. In together, out together, and no knot of men between the porch and this door.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will keep your pace, mistress.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And I will keep it. Sunday is the church and the house.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have the board. I will clear it when we are back, and not before.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Clear it when we are back. We are not late, and we are not early enough to stand in the lane talking.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am ready. There is no second errand.
